system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"Someone hacked my Spotify and deleted all of my playlists.. why would you do that to a person"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! I'm really sorry to hear that. Please DM us so we can help you get your account back on track! Keep us posted /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Avoid asking for DMs; guide to official support channels instead."}
